info.title: Epiphany
info.description: An in-memory OLAP server. Every response carries the header Epiphany-Model-Version, the version of the model it was answered from, so that a client holding a copy of a dimension knows when to fetch it again.

get.summary:
What the audit records, the newest first: each view of the server as another user, who
viewed and when. For administrators.

parameters.name: most
parameters.description: At most this many entries, the newest; 100 if not given, and never more than 1,000.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

500.description: The audit could not be read

get.summary:
The changes saved to the cells of every cube, or of one, the newest first: who made each,
when, to which cell, from what to what. Narrowed by cube, by user, and by time.

parameters.name: cube
parameters.description: Only changes to this cube.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Only changes made by this user, in any case.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only changes made from this time on, in seconds since 1970.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only changes made until this time, in seconds since 1970.

parameters.name: most
parameters.description: At most this many, the newest: 100 unless given, and never more than 1,000.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: Unknown cube, or the query is malformed

500.description: The history could not be read

get.summary:

back with `PUT /model`, which makes it the newest version. For administrators.

403.description: The user may not do this

get.summary: A model kept from before the current one, with the version it was. For administrators.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name it is kept under, as the list of earlier models gives it

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

404.description: No earlier model is kept under that name

500.description: The kept model could not be read

get.summary:
The state of the server: the cells each cube stores, what it keeps on disk, its open
sessions and transactions, and how long it has run. For administrators.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

get.summary:
The open transactions, the longest idle first. One is ended with
`POST /transactions/{id}/rollback`. For administrators.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

get.summary: The users, with their roles and how many sessions each has open. For administrators.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

put.summary:
Adds a user, or changes one's role, cube roles or password. It takes effect at once:
the user's open sessions hold the new roles from their next request. For administrators.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The user, ignoring case

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

409.description: The server has no users, so none can be added while it runs

422.description: A new user has no password, the change would leave no administrator, or the request body is malformed

delete.summary:
Removes a user and ends their sessions. The last administrator cannot be removed. For
administrators.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The user, ignoring case

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: It would leave no administrator

delete.summary: Ends every session of a user, who must sign in again. For administrators.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The user, ignoring case

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

post.summary:
Starts a view of the server as another user has it: a session of theirs that may only
read what they may read, and none of their sandboxes, naming the administrator viewing.
It is recorded in the audit first. Sign out of it as of any session. For administrators.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

500.description: The view could not be recorded, so it is not given

post.summary:
Writes a leaf cell's supporting detail, the lines its value is the sum of, and the sum to
the cell, as one write. A value written to the cell plainly later takes the detail away,
for its lines no longer add up to it; `POST /cells/explain` gives a cell's detail.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: The cell cannot be written, the lines are not a detail it can have, or the request body is malformed

500.description: The change could not be stored

post.summary:
Says how each cell comes by its value: stored, calculated by a rule or added up, whether
it can be written, and whether it is fed. A cell that cannot be explained reports its own
error.

200.description: An explanation or an error for each cell

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: The request body is malformed

post.summary:
The changes committed to a cell, the newest first: when, by whom, and from what to what.
The history is read after the database is let go, so that a long one holds up nobody.

200.description: The cell's changes, the newest first

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: No such cell, or the request body is malformed

500.description: The history could not be read

post.summary: Reads a batch of cells. A cell that cannot be read reports its own error.

200.description: A value or an error for each cell

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: The request body is malformed

post.summary:
Writes a value to a consolidated cell by sharing it out among its leaves, as one batch:
every leaf is written or none.

post.summary: Writes a batch of leaf cells: all of them, or none if any is refused.

get.summary:
Lists the cells a cube stores: its leaf cells that hold a value, with neither totals nor
cells a rule calculates. They come in a fixed order, so the whole can be taken a page at
a time, and what comes out can be written back with `POST /cells/write`, to this server or
another.

parameters.name: cube
parameters.description: Cube name, ignoring case and spaces

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many stored cells to pass over first. Zero unless given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most cells to return. Ten thousand unless given.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: Unknown cube

403.description: The user may not do this

delete.summary: Takes a comment away: its author may, and an administrator.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

get.summary:
Looks for leaf cells that a rule gives a value but no feeder feeds, which a fed cube's
consolidations therefore leave out. It works every calculated leaf out, so it is slow on
a large cube. At most a hundred cells are returned; none means the feeders are complete
for the data held, or the cube is not fed.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: Unknown cube, or a rule failed

get.summary:
The signed-in user's own views of a cube, by name: queries saved for them alone, beside
the cube's views, which everybody sees. A view as the user sees none of them.

parameters.name: cube
parameters.description: Cube name, ignoring case and spaces

200.description: The user's views of the cube

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

put.summary:
Saves a view of a cube for the signed-in user alone, in place of one of theirs of the
same name, case and spaces aside. Its query is run first, as theirs: it must select from
the cube, and they must be able to read what it reads. Each user's views may take 4 MiB.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The view's name, up to 120 characters

get.summary:
The model in outline: every cube, with its rules, views and checks, and every dashboard,
but each dimension only by its name, type and number of elements. What lists the cubes
and views asks for this; `GET /dimensions/{name}` gives a dimension whole.

200.description: The model, without its dimensions' elements

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

get.summary:
The signed-in user's sandboxes, in the order of their names. Values are read, written,
spread and queried in one with its transaction; `POST /transactions/{id}/commit`
publishes them, and `POST /transactions/{id}/rollback` empties it.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

post.summary:
Makes a sandbox for the signed-in user: a transaction kept under a name, which holds no
locks, never expires and outlives the server, for values to wait in until they are
published.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

422.description: The user has a sandbox of that name, or a sandbox cannot be called that

500.description: The sandbox could not be kept

delete.summary: Deletes one of the signed-in user's sandboxes, with the values it holds.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

404.description: The user has no sandbox of that name

401.description: Wrong name or password

404.description: The server has no users, so nothing needs signing in to

422.description: The request body is malformed

429.description: The name has been given too many wrong passwords, or too many sign-ins are waiting to be checked; the Retry-After header says how many seconds to wait

delete.summary: Signs out, ending the session whose token is sent.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

post.summary:
Begins a transaction, signed with the user who begins it: the history of cells records
its commit as theirs. It is rolled back if left idle.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

post.summary:
Stores a transaction's pending writes in one step and ends it. A sandbox's are published,
checked and locked as any commit's, and the sandbox stays open, empty. Values go only
into cubes the user may write to now, however long ago they were written.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

409.description: Publishing a sandbox: another transaction holds a lock, or has one of its cells pending

422.description: Publishing a sandbox: one of its values can no longer be written where it is

500.description: The change could not be stored

post.summary: Locks a cube or the whole server for a transaction until it ends.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

409.description: Another transaction holds a conflicting lock

422.description: Unknown cube, or the request body is malformed

get.summary: Says how far a transaction has come: a point to take it back to later.

200.description: The point the transaction has come to

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

post.summary: Discards a transaction's pending writes and ends it. A sandbox is emptied, and stays.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

post.summary:
Takes back a transaction's writes since a point it came to, the last first, so that each
cell is pending as it was then. Spreads and batches go back whole. The transaction stays
open.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended

403.description: The user may not do this

404.description: Unknown transaction, or a point it has not come to

422.description: The request body is malformed

ApiError.description: The one error shape used by every route.

code.description: A stable identifier for the kind of error.

index.description: The position of the offending cell in a batch.

position.description: Where in an MDX query the problem was found, counted in characters from zero.

AuditEntry.description: One thing kept on record: when, by whom, what, and as or of whom.

action.description: What they did, such as `view as`.

subject.description: Whom it was done as or to.

tuples.description: Each tuple holds one member per dimension on the axis.

additionalProperties.description: What a user may do. Each role may also do what the ones before it may.

CellChange.description: A change to a cell, as the history gives it back.

at.description: One element name for each dimension of the cube.

author.description: Who made it: the user who began the transaction it came in, where the server knew.

before.description: What the cell held before: zero, or empty text, where it held nothing.

time.description: When it was committed, in seconds since 1970.

CellRef.description: A cell addressed by cube name and one element name or alias per dimension.

CellWrite.description: A value to write to a leaf cell.

Comment.description: A note pinned to a cell.

at.description: One element name for each dimension of the cube.

written.description: When it was written, in seconds since 1970.

at.description: The cell: one element name or alias for each dimension of the cube.

Comparison.description: How a number is compared with a rule's value.

ContextMember.description: A member to stand at, by its dimension and its name or alias.

feeders.description:
Statements that say which calculated leaf cells may hold a value, each
`source => target, ...`, such as `[Account].[Revenue] => [Account].[Margin]`. A cube
that is fed consolidates only its stored and fed cells.

rules.description:
Statements that calculate cells, each `[N: | C: | S:] area = expression`. The area is a
member or a tuple, such as `[Account].[Margin]`; the expression is written as in MDX.
The first rule that covers a cell decides it.

validations.description: Checks of the values in the cube's cells, in the order they are made.

views.description: Saved queries against this cube, by name.

based_on.description: The model version the cube was edited from.

cells.description: How many leaf cells it stores.

DashboardDef.description: A page of tiles, each showing a view saved with a cube.

description.description: What the dashboard is for, shown beneath its name.

filters.description:
Dimensions the page offers a choice of member for. Every tile whose cube has one
stands at the member chosen, in place of the one its view names, unless the view
places the dimension on an axis.

layout.description: How the tiles are laid out.

tiles.description: The tiles, in the order they are laid out; in a free layout, each over those before.

DashboardLayout.description: How a dashboard lays its tiles out.

based_on.description: The model version the dashboard was edited from.

at.description: One element name or alias for each dimension of the cube.

lines.description:
The lines the cell's value is the sum of. None take the detail away and leave the
value as it is.

transaction.description:
Hold the detail and its value in this transaction, or this sandbox, until it commits.
Without it they are committed at once.

attributes.description: Declared attributes and their types. Elements may only carry attributes declared here.

levels.description:
Names for the dimension's levels, from the leaves up: the first names level zero. A
query may then say `[Period].[Quarter]` for the level, unless an element has that
name, and `Ytd`, `Qtd`, `Mtd` and `Wtd` look for the levels named Year, Quarter,
Month and Week.

subsets.description: Reusable selections of this dimension's elements, by name.

DimensionOutline.description: A dimension as the outline of the model gives it: by its name, type and size.

based_on.description: The model version the dimension was edited from.

DimensionView.description: A dimension with the hierarchy facts derived from its definition.

levels.description: The names of the levels, from the leaves up, where the model gives them.

subsets.description:
The element names each subset selects, in the subset's order; for a subset that reads
cells, as the stored cells stand now.

subsets_reading_cells.description: The subsets that read cells, which select what the cells say when they are used.

EarlierModel.description: A model kept from before the current one.

name.description: The name it is kept under, to ask for it by.

saved.description: When it was saved, in seconds since 1970, where the journal can say.

attributes.description: Attribute values, keyed by attribute name.

children.description: Weighted children, in order. Present on consolidated elements only.

oneOf.description:
For a string element of a cube's last dimension, the values its text cells may take:
offered as a list where they are written, and any other refused. Text stored before
is kept.

ElementView.description:
An element and its place in the hierarchy. Its parents, children and attributes are left
out where it has none, as a leaf has no children: in a large dimension, most of the
elements are leaves, and the empty lists were half of what was sent.

level.description: Zero for a leaf, otherwise one more than the highest child level.

picklist.description: For a string element with a picklist, the values its text cells may be given.

feeders.description:
Also say which feeders feed each cell and from where. This looks at every stored and
fed cell for each cell asked about, so ask it of few cells at a time.

transaction.description: Explain within this transaction, seeing its pending writes.

cells.description: One result per requested cell, in request order.

Explanation.description: How a cell comes by its value.

detail.description: The lines the cell's value is the sum of, where it was written with supporting detail.

fed.description:
For a numeric leaf of a cube that is fed, whether the cell is fed. A calculated cell
that holds a value but is not fed is missing from the cube's consolidations.

fed_by.description: The feeders that feed the cell, when asked for.

invalid.description: The checks of the cube that the cell's value breaks, in the order they are made.

oneOf.description: The rule that gives the cell its value, if one does.
What is stored at the cell, for a leaf or text cell. A rule may hide it.

writable.description: Whether a value can be written to the cell: it is not consolidated and no rule covers it.

FedBy.description:
A feeder that feeds a cell, and the cell it feeds it from. The feeder belongs to the cube
of that cell.

unfed.description: Calculated leaf cells that hold a value but are not fed.

Geometry.description:
The sizes a grid was given by hand: the height of its rows and the widths of columns,
each column known by a key of the client's choosing. Sizes not given are fitted to the
content.

row_height.description: The height of every row, in pixels.

widths.description: The width of each column, in pixels, by key.

HighlightRule.description: A colour for the numbers that meet a test against a value.

Highlights.description:
How a view draws the eye to numbers: bars, shades, and colours by rule. Totals take no
bar or shade, being out of scale with what they add up.

bars.description: A bar beneath each number, as long as its share of the largest in its column.

rules.description: Colours for the numbers that meet a test; the first rule a number meets decides.

shades.description: Each number shaded from the lowest in its column to the highest.

at.description: One element name or alias for each dimension of the cube.

most.description: At most this many changes, the newest: 100 unless given, and never more than 1,000.

Invalid.description: A check of a cube that a cell's value breaks.

message.description: What the check says of such a value.

refuses.description:
Whether the check refuses such a value as it is written. One it breaks all the same
was there before the check was.

Line.description: One line of a cell's supporting detail.

label.description: What the line is, such as `Flights to Lisbon`.

LockMode.description: A lock a client may ask for.

cube.description: The cube to lock. Without it the whole server is locked.

level.description: Zero for a leaf or a calculated member, otherwise one more than the highest child level.

properties.description: The attributes asked for with `PROPERTIES`, where the member has a value for them.

MembersDef.description: The elements of a dimension, or of one of its subsets, as a picklist offers them.

dashboards.description: Pages of saved views, each shown as a chart, a figure or a grid.

ModelOutline.description:
The model in outline: its cubes and dashboards whole, and its dimensions without their
elements, so that it stays small however large the dimensions grow.

version.description: Counts up by one with every update.

based_on.description:
The version the new definition was edited from. The update is refused if it is no
longer the current version.

ModelUpdate.description: The outcome of a model update.

dropped_cells.description: Stored cells that have no place in the new model and were discarded.

ModelView.description: The model definition and its version.

version.description: Counts up by one with every update.

NumberFormat.description:
How numbers are shown. Only the showing changes: values are read, written and copied in
full.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal sign, always shown.

parentheses.description: Negative numbers in parentheses, as accounts show them, rather than after a minus.

oneOf.description: The unit numbers are shown in.

OwnSubset.description: A subset a user keeps for themself: the members it holds, in order.

elements.description: The members, by name or alias; each is kept by its name.

PicklistDef.description:
The values a text cell may take: given one by one, or the elements of a dimension, or of
one of its subsets, in order.

context.description:
Members to stand at, each in place of the member the query's WHERE names for its
dimension, or beside them. An axis that places one of their dimensions keeps only its
members at that member or beneath it, and the query's own calculated members. A page's
selectors use it to show one saved query at other members.

mdx.description: The query text, for example `SELECT {[Entity].[US]} ON COLUMNS FROM [General Ledger]`.

transaction.description: Query within this transaction, seeing its pending writes.

QueryResult.description:
The answer to a query.

`cells` holds one value per combination of a tuple from each axis, the first axis varying
fastest. With columns and rows that is row by row: the cell of row `r` and column `c` is at
`r * columns + c`. With columns only there is one cell per column, and with no axes a
single cell. A cell with no value, such as a division by zero, is null.

axes.description: The columns axis, then the rows axis, then any further axes the query has.

formatted.description:
The cells written out, one for each of `cells`, where a calculated member that
decides them has a `FORMAT_STRING`: as its pattern says, the way `Format` writes a
number or a date, and null for the others. Left out where no calculated member of the
query has a format.

slicer.description:
The members the `WHERE` clause narrows the query to. A dimension that is neither here
nor on an axis stands at its first top element.

transaction.description: Read within this transaction, seeing its pending writes.

cells.description: One result per requested cell, in request order.

Role.description: What a user may do. Each role may also do what the ones before it may.

Sandbox.description: A sandbox as its owner sees it.

pending.description: How many cells it holds values for, not yet published.

transaction.description: The transaction to read, write and query in it with. It is kept and never expires.

name.description: A name none of the user's other sandboxes has, case and spaces aside.

Scale.description: A unit numbers are shown in.

earlier_models_bytes.description: The bytes of every model kept from before it.

log_bytes.description: The bytes of recorded commits since the last snapshot.

memory_bytes.description: The memory the server holds, where the operating system says.

model_bytes.description: The bytes of the model as it is.

server.description: The version of the server program.

sessions.description: How many sessions are open; none on a server that asks no one to sign in.

snapshot_bytes.description: The bytes of the last snapshot.

uptime_seconds.description: How long the server has been running, in seconds.

cubes.description: The cubes on which the user has another role in place of that one.

elements.description: The elements with a role of their own, which holds beneath them too.

idle_seconds.description: The session ends when it has not been used for this many seconds.

token.description: Send this with every request, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

viewer.description: For a view as another user, the administrator viewing.

Spread.description: A value to share out among the leaves of a consolidated cell.

holds.description:
Cells the spread leaves as they are, each by one element name or alias for each
dimension: a leaf, or a consolidated cell whose leaves are all held. The value given is
shared among the other leaves, less what the held ones add to it.

transaction.description:
Hold the writes in this transaction until it commits. Without it they are committed
at once.

written.description: How many leaf cells were written.

Statement.description: A rule or feeder of a cube: its place in the cube's list, counted from one, and its text.

StoredCells.description: Some of the stored cells of a cube.

cells.description: The cells of this page, in a form `POST /cells/write` takes back.

total.description: How many cells the cube stores in all.

oneOf.description: The elements, by name or alias, in the order given.

elements.description: The elements, by name or alias, in the order given.

oneOf.description:
An MDX set over the dimension, such as `TM1FilterByLevel([Period].Members, 0)`. It is
worked out from the dimension alone, so it cannot depend on cell values.

mdx.description:
An MDX set over the dimension, such as `TM1FilterByLevel([Period].Members, 0)`. It is
worked out from the dimension alone, so it cannot depend on cell values.

SubsetDef.description: A selection of a dimension's elements.

TileDef.description: One tile of a dashboard: a view of a cube and how it is shown, or a few lines of text.

by_columns.description: A chart's series are the view's columns, rather than its rows.

cube.description: The cube of the view shown; none for a tile of text.

labels.description: A chart writes each value on its mark.

oneOf.description:
Where the tile stands and how large it is. Without one it takes the next place
there is, as wide as `width` says.

text.description:
What a tile of text says: a line that begins `# ` is a heading, one that begins `- `
an item of a list, and an empty line ends a paragraph.

title.description: A title of its own; the view's name unless given.

view.description: A view saved with the cube.

width.description: How many of two columns the tile takes where it has no `place`: one or two.

TilePlace.description:
Where a tile stands on its dashboard's page: in columns from the left, of the twelve
across, and in rows from the top, each of a fixed height. A free layout may place a tile
between them.

TileShow.description: How a tile shows its view.

Tone.description: What a highlight says of a number.

idle_seconds.description: How long since it was last used, in seconds.

pending.description: How many writes it holds, waiting to be committed.

TransactionPoint.description: How far a transaction has come.

point.description:
How many writes the transaction has been given. Its writes since this point can be
taken back with `POST /transactions/{id}/undo`.

to.description: The point to go back to, as `GET /transactions/{id}/point` gave it.

signing_in.description:
Whether the server asks users to sign in. Without users it does not, and none can be
added while it runs.

UserPut.description: A user to add or change.

cubes.description: Cubes on which the user has another role in place of that one.

elements.description:
Elements with a role of their own, by dimension and element: none, read or write. It
holds beneath the element too, unless a nearer element has its own; an element beneath
several takes the highest of theirs. An administrator is bound by none.

password.description: A new password. A new user needs one; without it a user's password is kept.

UserView.description: A user as an administrator sees them: never the password.

cubes.description: The cubes on which the user has another role in place of that one.

elements.description:
The elements with a role of their own, by dimension and element: `none`, `read` or
`write`, holding beneath them too where nearer elements have none.

sessions.description: How many sessions the user has open.

ValidationDef.description:
A check of the values in an area of a cube. A value written where it does not hold is
refused, or, where the check only warns, kept and marked as breaking it.

cells.description:
The cells checked: an area as a rule names one, such as `N: [Account].[Salaries]`;
`N:`, `C:` or `S:` before it keeps to leaf, consolidated or text cells.

message.description: What is said of a value where the check does not hold.

refuse.description: Whether such a value is refused as it is written, rather than kept and warned of.

valid.description:
What holds wherever a value is acceptable, written as a rule's expression is and
worked out at each cell checked, such as `[Account].[Salaries] >= 0`. True, any number
but zero and any text but none hold; so does an expression that cannot be worked out.

user.description: The user to view the server as, ignoring case.

ViewDef.description: A saved query against a cube.

oneOf.description: How the view shows its numbers; as the reader's locale writes them unless given.
The sizes the grid of the view was given, kept with it.
How the view draws the eye to some numbers.

mdx.description: The MDX query, which must select from the cube the view belongs to.

transaction.description:
Hold the writes in this transaction until it commits. Without it they are committed
at once.
